description: iec104-python is Fraunhofer FIT DIEN's Python module for simulating SCADA systems and remote terminal units that communicate using IEC 60870-5-104. It combines the lib60870-C protocol implementation with state structures and Python callbacks, providing client, server, station and data-point objects. Inputs are simulated measurements, commands, addresses and reporting settings; outputs are protocol exchanges and application callbacks. Coverage is a configurable control-network test environment without a fixed geography or observation period. Public source and the c104 package are free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that protocol emulation does not itself model electrical or hydraulic plant dynamics, and the documented Python and operating-system support must be checked before deployment. Dependencies have their own notices. The module can supply communication components for electricity-control and resilience simulations, complementary to PyPSA (model-pypsa). Its README provides local client and server examples and links API documentation. No live controller, network endpoint or industrial device was contacted.
